about: The GTA 5 money machine: $800M day one and $1B in 3 days (Take-Two, Sept 2013), the FY2015 drop, GTA Online and Shark Cards, three console generations, 230M+ sold-in (Take-Two 10-Q, Aug 2026), over $10B from GTA products FY2014-FY2026 (our math from Take-Two 10-Ks), hand-off to GTA 6 on Nov 19 2026. Delta weekly long video, 16:9 1920x1080, 6 chapter cards, 10 s end card.

lines.text: GTA 5 is thirteen years old, and it's still selling.
lines.say: G T A 5 is thirteen years old, and it's still selling.

lines.text: Over 230 million copies, by Take-Two's own count.
lines.say: Over two hundred thirty million copies, by Take-Two's own count.

lines.text: So how does one game keep paying for thirteen years?
Six chapters. The numbers come from Take-Two's own reports.
Chapter one. Three days.
First question: how fast can a game make a billion dollars?
GTA 5 launched on a Tuesday. September 17th, 2013.
lines.say: G T A 5 launched on a Tuesday. September seventeenth, twenty thirteen.

lines.text: Day one: over 800 million dollars in sales.
lines.say: Day one: over eight hundred million dollars in sales.

lines.text: That's Take-Two's estimate, without Japan and Brazil.
Day three: more than one billion dollars.
Take-Two said no game or movie had ever been that fast.
By our math, that's about 14 million dollars an hour.
lines.say: By our math, that's about fourteen million dollars an hour.

lines.text: A billion dollars, before its first Friday.
Chapter two. The drop.
So what happens when the launch party ends?
Take-Two's year runs from April to March.
In its next year, GTA sales fell.
lines.say: In its next year, G T A sales fell.

lines.text: Down by about $1.3 billion.
lines.say: Down by about one point three billion.

lines.text: That's Take-Two's own number, from its 2015 annual report.
lines.say: That's Take-Two's own number, from its twenty fifteen annual report.

lines.text: The reason it gave: the year before had the launch.
lines.say: The reason it gave: the year before had the launch.

lines.text: Part of the new PlayStation 4 money was booked later, Take-Two says.
Still, even GTA 5 fell off a cliff.
lines.say: Still, even G T A 5 fell off a cliff.

lines.text: Chapter three. The second game.
So how does a game you already bought keep earning?
Two weeks after launch, Rockstar switched on GTA Online.
lines.say: Two weeks after launch, Rockstar switched on G T A Online.

lines.text: It came free with every copy of GTA 5.
lines.say: It came free with every copy of G T A 5.

lines.text: But inside it, you could buy game cash with real money.
Rockstar calls them Shark Cards.
In 2018, Take-Two said GTA Online's virtual cash helped drive its growth.
lines.say: In twenty eighteen, Take-Two said G T A Online's virtual cash helped drive its growth.

lines.text: Meanwhile, Rockstar kept adding free updates. Heists arrived in 2015.
lines.say: Meanwhile, Rockstar kept adding free updates. Heists arrived in twenty fifteen.

lines.text: By 2020, Take-Two said the updates were setting player records.
lines.say: By twenty twenty, Take-Two said the updates were setting player records.

lines.text: Then in 2022 came GTA Plus, a monthly membership.
lines.say: Then in twenty twenty two came G T A Plus, a monthly membership.

lines.text: Across all of Take-Two's games, look at spending inside games.
Back in 2017, about a quarter of its revenue.
lines.say: Back in twenty seventeen, about a quarter of its revenue.

lines.text: Over three quarters by this March.
GTA Online was free. The money inside it wasn't.

lines.text: Chapter four. Three generations.
How many times can you sell the same game?
2013: PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360.
lines.say: Twenty thirteen: PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360.

lines.text: November 2014: PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. Then PC, in April 2015.
lines.say: November twenty fourteen: PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. Then P C, in April twenty fifteen.

lines.text: March 2022: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.
lines.say: March twenty twenty two: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.

lines.text: Same city, same story. Three generations of consoles.
Each time, the same city went on sale again. And the count kept climbing.
Over 32 million copies by early 2014.
lines.say: Over thirty two million copies by early twenty fourteen.

lines.text: Over 100 million by 2019.
lines.say: Over one hundred million by twenty nineteen.

lines.text: Over 230 million by this August.
lines.say: Over two hundred thirty million by this August.

lines.text: Chapter five. The machine.
So what does it all add up to?
Every year, Take-Two reports what share of its revenue is GTA.
lines.say: Every year, Take-Two reports what share of its revenue is G T A.

lines.text: We multiplied it out, year by year, thirteen years.
On the left, the launch year. 1.6 billion dollars.

lines.text: On the right, every year after it.
Watch the right side keep going.
About 9 billion more.

lines.text: Together, over 10 billion dollars from GTA games.

Chapter six. The hand-off.
So what happens to the machine now?
In the launch year, GTA was about 69 percent of Take-Two's revenue.
